title: Lakadong Turmeric under Protected Cultivation – Part 2: A Unique High-Curcumin Germplasm
excerpt: This article examines Lakadong turmeric as a distinct high-curcumin germplasm originating from the North-Eastern Himalayan region of India. It discusses its genetic uniqueness, exceptional curcumin concentration, and comparative advantages over conventional turmeric varieties. The section highlights why Lakadong turmeric is increasingly sought after for nutraceutical and pharmaceutical applications and why it requires specialised, quality-focused cultivation strategies to realise its full commercial and scientific potential.
